item.title: BlackGateWatch: A DNS Tunnel Hiding in Plain Sight
item.description: Three thousand frames of ordinary corporate DNS, and one workstation quietly hex-encoding data into subdomains of its own domain. No TXT records, no long labels, no obvious tell.

item.title: Sidedoor: The Cloud Backup That Was Uploading the Secret
item.description: A pcap full of normal traffic and one host quietly posting a backup file to a cloud sync endpoint over plain HTTP. The recovery token is in the upload. No crypto required.

item.title: Phantom Drop: A PowerShell Dropper Wearing a Windows Update Badge
item.description: A 45-packet capture, 52 seconds long, that shows a Windows implant checking in, pulling a payload, staging it, and mailing credentials home. Almost all of it is plain HTTP, and the flag is sitting in the exfil report.

item.title: Packet Whisperer: The One Where DNS Snitched on Itself
item.description: DNS exfiltration reversed from a PCAP, pure Python, zero Wireshark. A complete walkthrough of how attackers smuggle data out via DNS TXT queries and how to catch them.
